_meta.approved_deltas: raw/approved_deltas.json - an entry covers exactly one difference (product + pointer + before + after), must name registered_by, and only subtask 05 may register
_meta.axle_entry: preparation.kc_quasi_static.assembly_for(model, mode, rig=<bench>) - called once per wheel-supplying bench
_meta.check_scope: differences are judged on the assemblies and rigs nodes; _meta differences are reported but do not fail the check
_meta.coverage_boundary: a vehicle bench binds itself in the study layer, which this snapshot does not cover: for the five vehicle benches 05 must use its own runtime comparison, not this file alone
_meta.determinism: no timestamp, no environment value, no absolute path is stored; the run's own time is recorded in raw/snapshot_notes.md
_meta.force_column: a K reading carries no element: its force column is the ideal-joint row (constraints/ideal_constraints); bushings/elements belong to the C reading - the F9 layering
_meta.product_keys: axle_<mode>@<bench> for the wheel-supplying benches, so a change that reaches only one bench cannot hide behind a shared key; vehicle for the rest
